options.name: init_config
options.description: All options defined here are available to all instances.

options.name: service
options.description:
Attach the tag `service:<SERVICE>` to every metric, event, and service check emitted by this integration.

Additionally, this sets the default `service` for every log source.

options.name: instances
options.description: Every instance is scheduled independently of the others.

options.name: enable_realtime_bandwidth
options.description:
Enable org-wide realtime bandwidth monitoring.  When true (the default),
the check fetches total bytes downloaded and request count for the
entire organization with no filters.  The interval used is controlled
by bandwidth_interval.

options.name: bandwidth_interval
options.description:
Time granularity for all bandwidth collection (org-wide AND profiles).
Must be one of: minute, five_minutes, fifteen_minutes, hour, day,
week, month, year.  Defaults to five_minutes.

options.name: bandwidth_profiles
options.description:
Named bandwidth monitoring profiles.  Each profile queries the Cloudsmith
analytics time-series API with its own aggregate and filters.  The
interval is shared via the top-level bandwidth_interval setting.
Metrics are tagged with profile:<name> plus tags for every configured
filter key.

options.name: billable_only
options.description:
Limit analytics to billable download requests only.
When True (the default), only download-domain requests with HTTP status < 400 are counted.
When False, all traffic including native CDN logs and errored requests is returned.

options.name: tags
options.description:
A list of tags to attach to every metric and service check emitted by this instance.

Learn more about tagging at https://docs.datadoghq.com/tagging

options.name: service
options.description:
Attach the tag `service:<SERVICE>` to every metric, event, and service check emitted by this integration.

Overrides any `service` defined in the `init_config` section.

options.name: min_collection_interval
options.description:
This changes the collection interval of the check. For more information, see:
https://docs.datadoghq.com/developers/write_agent_check/#collection-interval

options.name: empty_default_hostname
options.description:
This forces the check to send metrics with no hostname.

This is useful for cluster-level checks.

options.name: metric_patterns
options.description:
A mapping of metrics to include or exclude, with each entry being a regular expression.

Metrics defined in `exclude` will take precedence in case of overlap.
